scope: One study, four national survey versions, restricted to reconstructable conditions. Not four independent replications.

cold_start.selection_basis: User-approved probability/background hypotheses and fixed pilot prompt, not target-development outcomes. No target answers in model context.
cold_start.argmax_diagnostic: Use same rich probability vectors; report tied maxima, deterministic first-index argmax and position limitation. No extra call.

calibrated.main: development-selected temperature and convex blend of rich probability output and rich statistical baseline
calibrated.selection: Training fits statistical parameters; development selects regularization and probability calibration; test scored once after all selections freeze. Weight zero means statistics-only, not AI improvement.

sample_rationale: Use all eligible held-out respondents, not a favorable subsample. Pilot validates cost/format only; no power claim. A small effect may remain inconclusive at 292 test people.
primary_scoring: Person-averaged multiclass Brier; paired respondent bootstrap 2000 within country-treatment strata; relative improvement >=2% and positive 95% interval. Distribution errors by exact choice card, separately; country subgroups descriptive.
shuffle_policy: Preserve country-treatment, split, exact age and education labels; shuffle whole household/use blocks. Report all people and separately the 219 test people with actual changed content. No causal-personality claim.
leakage: Inputs whitelist only; no targets, weights or identifiers transmitted. Test outcomes are not used to alter model or configuration.
limitations: Financial comfort omitted pending timing clarity; rich means richer than basic, not a complete profile.
Other independent studies and synthetic-persona validation remain required for overall project completion.
